text:
Alex: Quick question — when a saved query is pinned to a route, should the console show a routing/quota nudge inline? I'm seeing customers confused about which model/slot will be used and why sample rates change.
Maya: yes we should surface a lightweight hint. maybe collapsed by default. users hit the pin, then see: "Pinned to /checkout (uses model-x, sample 10%)"
TJ: are we talking about telemetry-only hints or actionable UI? actionable hints imply we need to expose the effective routing policy in the view payload.
Alex: actionable — at least show the computed routing policy and the quota impact. product wants it to be obvious before they run expensive compares.
Sarah: +1. UX ask: show the model, sampling rate, and a link to explain fallback rules. small inline pill with `?` tooltip should do it.
Maya: from an API perspective we can add an optional field on the savedview response: `routing_preview` with { model, sample_rate, fallback_chain }. keeps existing contract backward compatible.
TJ: caution: we need to avoid leaking internal region/fleet names. `routing_preview` should be user-friendly (e.g. "Model: Llama-2-13b-quant, Sample: 10% (compare uses pinned model)").
Sarah: agree. also add a `confidence` flag if preview is estimated (e.g., when autoscaling/burst policies could change the actual route).
Alex: how heavy is the computation for that preview? we can't block list calls.
Maya: cheap — it's the same logic runtime uses for quick routing heuristics. we'll cache per-savedview for 5m. TTL + a small async recompute on rollout.
TJ: implementation note: don't call the full placement engine in the request path. use the routing policy evaluator (fast path). fallback to `estimated` if the fast path is uncertain.
console-bot: deploy-check: `api/savedviews` schema change planned; feature flag `preview-routing-pill` will gate UX until QOL tweaks done.
Sarah: rollout plan? opt-in flag for a cohort, capture clicks on the pill + telemetry whether they ran compare after seeing hint.
Alex: yep — cohort A will get pill, cohort B no pill. measure conversion to compare and reduction in surprise incidents.
Maya: I'll sketch API patch: small nullable `routing_preview` string + `routing_preview_meta` for confidence. PR by EOD.
TJ: I'll add server-side caching and a fallthrough that returns {"estimated": true} if uncertain.
Alex: perfect. one last thing — wording. UX team wants "Estimate" not "Preview". can we use that in the tooltip copy?
Sarah: fine. "Estimate" + tooltip explaining that autoscaling or reserved capacity can change this. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks everyone — filed a tiny follow-up doc in product drive and linked in the PR.
Maya: thanks, will tag the rollout ticket when PR is open.
TJ: noted for infra — we'll monitor for extra evals.
console-bot: PR opened by @maya: https://git.internal/r/redwood/savedviews/+/2345, feature flag `preview-routing-pill` set to off in prod.
